A copper alloy Roman coin; a nummus of Reece Period 17, struck for Constantius II (AD 337-361), and dating from AD 337-341. The coin has a diameter of 14.75mm and a thickness of 1.19mm. It weighs 1.20g. GLORIA EXERCITVS reverse type depicting two soldiers standing either side of a single standard. TRP in exergue, denoting mint of Trier; the letter G in standard. Obverse: bust facing right, diadem…
